message:
support cpp2.ref = shared_const

Summary:
In order to support shared const ref which wraps the type T as `std::shared_ptr<const T>`, we need to be able to address recursive declarations of `TypeToInfo<TypeClass, T>`.

The recursive declarations won't work when we take `std::shared_ptr<const T>::element_type` since we have no specializations of the form `TypeToInfo<TypeClass, const T>`.

The trick here is to use `std::remove_cv_t` on `::element_type` to normalize the recursive declarations.

Fixed up read path when a smart ptr type could have been default constructed to point to nullptr, instead we need to initialize it using `std::make_share|unique` accordingly before reading.

Fixed up write path when a smart ptr type could have been default constructed to point to nullptr, we deref non trivial types up front to check for nullptr before writing.

Merged `derefSmartPointer` into `get` function, and `initialize` into `set` function.

Refactored `set` to return the pointer so that we can initialize and use the pointer in one function call.

Added ThriftValue abstraction to enable `get` function to both deref and get the value in one function call and simplify write path.

Added unit test.
